    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])

    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        a = list(map(int, input[index:index + 2 * n]))
        index += 2 * n
        counter = Counter(a)
        sorted_a = sorted(a, reverse=True)
        used = set()
        operations = []
        possible = True
        x = None
        for i in range(n):
            found_pair = False
            for j in range(len(sorted_a)):
                if sorted_a[j] not in used:
                    target = x if x is not None else sorted_a[j] + sorted_a[-1]
                    if target - sorted_a[j] in counter and counter[target - sorted_a[j]] > (1 if target - sorted_a[j] == sorted_a[j] else 0):
                        used.add(sorted_a[j])
                        used.add(target - sorted_a[j])
                        counter[sorted_a[j]] -= 1
                        counter[target - sorted_a[j]] -= 1
                        operations.append((target - sorted_a[j], sorted_a[j]))
                        x = max(sorted_a[j], target - sorted_a[j])
                        found_pair = True
                        break
            if not found_pair:
                possible = False
                break
        if possible:
            results.append("YES")
            results.append(str(x))
            for op in operations:
                results.append(f"{op[0]} {op[1]}")
        else:
            results.append("NO")
    print("\n".join(results))
